name: HH regime-switch 08 — Fear-extreme capitulation reversion long (daily, short hold)
rationale: MECHANISM: Crypto Fear & Greed <20 marks retail capitulation — liquidated leverage and panic redemptions dump into thin books while patient capital buys the dislocation. This is a CRYPTO-NATIVE sentiment read (funding, dominance, social) distinct from the equity-vol VIX signals — different information, different crowd. Block Research backtest (buy<20/sell>80) returned 1,240% vs 680% buy-and-hold 2018-2025. The known problem is that the published edge carries a ~147-day mean hold and a 52% LUNA drawdown — which would BREACH the Gate's maxDD<=25% outright. So this variant deliberately forces the SHORT-hold regime: enter on fear_greed below a fitted extreme floor with price washed down (ret_Nd negative), and exit fast on fear_greed recovering back up (crowd un-panics) or stop/TP/time, keeping holds short enough to bound drawdown. Entry uses fear_greed + ret_Nd only — the purest capitulation read. DISCONFIRMER: if the sub-20 entries cannot produce positive net-of-fee returns at holds short enough to keep maxDD<=25%, the edge is inseparable from unacceptable tail risk — kill it. Kill outright if the only profitable version needs >25% DD (the 147-day hold), or if post-2023 sub-20 events are flat (2018-2021 carried it).
catalyst: Fear & Greed capitulation extreme into a washed-down price — patient-capital dislocation buy
